1.consolidated_definition: Sí, está bien. Expresión de acuerdo o consentimiento. Derivado de las siglas: O.K., de origen incierto; posible moda coloquial de Boston y Nueva York que deformaba las palabras para escribirlas como se pronunciaban . La primera documentación es de 1841. Anglicismo crudo, usual. “Es un bocón, okay, pero tú no matas a alguien por ser un bocón”, dijo el abogado, refiriéndose a su cliente (El Nuevo Día, 25-10-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Yes, it's fine. Expression of agreement or consent. Derived from the initials O.K., of uncertain origin; possible colloquial fashion of Boston and New York that distorted words to write them as they were pronounced. The first documentation is from 1841. Raw anglicism, common. "It's a fool, okay, but you don't kill someone for being a fool," said the lawyer, referring to his client (The New Day, October 25, 2006)
